role: Senior Snowflake & BI Developer – Treasury Finance
responsibilities: Act as a technical liaison with Treasury, Finance, Data Architecture, Engineering, Operations, Risk, and dependent technology teams.
Partner directly with Treasury and Finance users to understand reporting requirements, financial calculations, business rules, and data dependencies.
Communicate development progress, data-quality issues, risks, dependencies, and technical recommendations.
Work collaboratively with Solution Architects, Data Architects, Business Analysts, and application teams.
Support analysis and resolution of data and reporting discrepancies.
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable Snowflake data solutions, including advanced SQL transformations, dimensional models, financial data marts, and reusable data components.
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, aggregate, and publish Treasury and Finance data from multiple source systems.
Design and develop Power BI dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, calculations, and DAX measures supporting Treasury and Finance reporting and analytics.

Optimize Snowflake queries, data structures, and processing patterns for performance, scalability, and efficient resource utilization, while troubleshooting data issues across upstream and downstream layers.
Implement data-quality, reconciliation, and reporting controls to ensure Power BI outputs reconcile to approved source data and financial control totals.
Partner with Treasury and Finance users to translate business requirements into data requirements, reporting specifications, transformation rules, and source-to-target mappings.
Collaborate with Data and Solution Architects to design target-state data models and flows, maintaining traceability from source systems through Snowflake to Power BI.
Maintain required data models, mappings, and technical documentation.
Implement data-quality, validation, and reconciliation controls across source systems, Snowflake, and reporting layers.
Maintain data lineage, governance, security, and access controls for Treasury and Finance data.
Support the full development lifecycle, including testing, UAT, code review, deployment, and production support.
